notes: Exact JBL Paragon / D44000 entry in Audio Database (a secondary, exact-model source, not a JBL-hosted page). Its shared model-rating table states a three-way, six-speaker integrated stereo loudspeaker system, 96 dB/W/m output sound-pressure level, 8 Ω impedance and 125 W allowable input (continuous program). The page explicitly distinguishes initial D44000, mid-term D44000, and late D44000WXA revisions and documents differing woofer/midrange assemblies; the single woofer field is therefore left N/A rather than merging revision-specific diameters. JBL's own article confirms the exact Paragon D44000 identity and says its pictured unit is an early model: https://jp.jbl.com/jamaica.html. The JBL article does not publish numeric specifications. No frequency-response limits, response curve, or directivity data are imported. Source for populated fields: https://audio-database.com/JBL/speaker/paragon.html.
